subject: Recap + quick poke on the deck — can I walk you through?
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kai Reynolds <kai.reynolds@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood estimate + brief recap from today

Hi Kai —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery: ClearBridge is trying to reduce inference cost on summary generation for patient notes while keeping median latency under 350ms for triage workflows. We talked about a pilot on a subset of workloads (ED notes, 10k/day) and a rollout path if P0 metrics hit the SLA.

Attached is the estimate I mentioned with a few configuration options (batching, quantization profile, and an initial dedicated pool vs hosted). I highlighted the option that maps to the latency/cost target we discussed.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_Estimate_ClearBridge_20261118.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

Next steps I suggested on the call:
- You confirm which workload slice to pilot (ED notes vs outpatient summaries)
- Redwood sends a short SOW + timeline for pilot (1–2 weeks to stand up, 4 week evaluation)
- Schedule a 30-min technical runthrough (we can do a fast live demo and review config choices)

Would love to lock a slot for next week to walk through the estimate and tradeoffs — are you available for 30 minutes on Tue/Wed mornings PT?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.com] | (415) 555-0187

--
Jordan Blake
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kai Reynolds <kai.reynolds@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up: did the estimate land?

Hi Kai —

Just following up on the estimate I sent last week (attached again below). I haven't heard back and wanted to check whether this is still on your radar or if priorities have shifted. Summary in one line: the highlighted configuration is designed to hit your <350ms median latency goal at ~10k/day while reducing token cost by ~40% vs your current hosted configuration.

If it helps, I can:
- Walk through the PDF with your engineering/infra lead in a 20–30 minute screen share
- Run a short, no-commit pilot that demonstrates latency on a small sample set

Re-attached: Redwood_Estimate_ClearBridge_20261118.pdf

If you're not the right person for the pilot/decision, could you point me to who owns this? If now isn't the right time, a quick note on timing (Q1 vs Q2) helps us prioritize.

Thanks for the nudge either way —
Jordan

Thanks for the nudge and for re-sending the estimate. Apologies — this got deprioritized while we finished a vendor security review. I pulled the deck this morning and skimmed it. A few quick notes from my side:
- The latency targets look in the right ballpark; I need our infra lead (Aisha) to confirm the sample size assumptions.
- Pricing looks reasonable for a pilot but procurement will ask for a short SOW and payment terms.

Would be great to do a 30-minute walkthrough next Tue (Dec 1) at 10:00 AM PT so I can bring Aisha and our procurement lead. Can you confirm availability? If you can send a 1-page SOW and a short pilot timeline before the call, that would speed things up.
